entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: An angel prayed to in a children's prayer, said to fly on snow-white wings.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: A nation whose citizens are organized into star-clans that interlace the Seven Houses.

entities.name: History of Benalia
entities.description: An in-world writing about the Benalish.

entities.name: Seven Houses
entities.description: The houses of Benalia, interlaced by star-clan loyalty.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A speaker who praises an undefeated champion of the empire and describes coatls.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A speaker urging his allies to hold nothing back for freedom and the future.

entities.name: Sursi
entities.description: A place whose unicorns manifest Serra's joy and compassion.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: A figure whose joy and compassion are manifested in the unicorns of Sursi.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane whose corrupted angelic hosts formed the Flight of Nightmares, and where Liliana practiced necromancy.

entities.name: Flight of Nightmares
entities.description: A host formed from the remnants of Innistrad's corrupted angelic hosts.

entities.name: Stitcher Geralf
entities.description: A stitcher who says improvement is a consequence of practice.

entities.name: Keyta
entities.description: A rebel hydromancer who calls on the sea without mage-rings or mana equations.

entities.name: Zahid, Djinn of the Lamp
entities.description: A djinn who is amused by mortals' wishes.

entities.name: Zendikari
entities.description: The people of Zendikar, vastly outnumbered and finding creative ways to even the odds.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer who honed her powers on Innistrad by practicing on undead and sometimes the living.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A world of death and decay where corpses are currency among necromancers and demons.

entities.name: Udvil "Ratty" Ratlock
entities.description: A speaker who taunts a vampire.

entities.name: Curse of Wandering
entities.description: A curse that leaves only hatred.

entities.name: Thallids
entities.description: Creatures, some of which escaped into the fens of Urborg and emulated the Cabal's rituals.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: A place with fens where thallids escaped to.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: A group known for bloodsoaked rituals.

entities.name: Zulaport
entities.description: A dangerous place to walk at night with full pockets.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Creatures considered less dangerous than Zulaport at night by one speaker.

entities.name: Captain Brandis Thorn
entities.description: A captain who advises blowing holes in hulls and regisaurs alike.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A world described as always angry.

entities.name: Nablus
entities.description: A North Hada trapper.

entities.name: North Hada
entities.description: A region home to the trapper Nablus.

entities.name: Sergeant Ryda
entities.description: A sergeant warning others to run from a seismic elemental.

entities.name: God-Pharaoh
entities.description: A figure whose embrace and afterlife were one great deception.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A speaker who came to understand the filigree creatures of another world; she faced an evil inside a mountain.

entities.name: Khemses
entities.description: A charioteer urging forward.

entities.name: Chammi
entities.description: A curio vendor selling filigree familiars.

entities.name: Djeru
entities.description: A former Tah-crop initiate who believes the gods' ideals remain true despite the deception.

entities.name: Tah-crop
entities.description: A crop of initiates of which Djeru was a member.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: The authority the renegades fought using constructs.

entities.name: Renegades
entities.description: Rebels who used constructs against the Consulate.

events.summary: The remnants of Innistrad's corrupted angelic hosts collapsed to form the Flight of Nightmares.
events.quote: The remnants of Innistrad's corrupted angelic hosts collapsed to form the Flight of Nightmares.

events.summary: Liliana embraced necromancy on Innistrad, practicing on undead and sometimes the living.
events.quote: On Innistrad, Liliana embraced necromancy, honing her powers by practicing on scores of undead—and sometimes the living.

events.summary: Escaped thallids in Urborg began emulating the Cabal's rituals.
events.quote: Some of the thallids that escaped into the fens of Urborg began emulating the Cabal's bloodsoaked rituals in their own peculiar way.

events.summary: The evil inside a mountain struck Nissa with a shock wave of madness.
events.quote: The evil inside the mountain pulsed at Nissa in a shock wave of madness.

events.summary: Renegades used constructs against the Consulate.
events.quote: Most of the constructs the renegades used against the Consulate weren't originally intended for combat.
